% Place the caret anywhere in each tikzpicture and edit without saving.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta}
\begin{document}

\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[width=8cm,height=4cm,xlabel={$x$},ylabel={$x^2$},grid=major]
  \addplot[blue,thick,domain=0:2,samples=30]{x^2};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}

\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[blue,thick,->] (0,0) -- (3,1);
  \node[draw,circle] at (1,1) {$x^2$};
\end{tikzpicture}

\end{document}
